svg.title: ARC White-Box Estimation Challenge - Phase 2
svg.desc: All 642 research questions and 34 added development and build records form one integrated tree. The estimator development passes through the analytic baseline, recorded corrections, rebuilt core and final fitting. Colored borders show recorded outcomes. Open graph/index.html for interactive zoom and evidence.
